# HEVN: Brex for Non-US Internet Companies

Operate in USD — without needing a US entity.

Peter Volnov

HEVN, inc

HEVN: Brex for non-US companies

\\Tl;Dr;\\  
 Banking for non-US internet companies is hard. HEVN provides an alternative: open virtual bank accounts in 1 day, get USD cards with 0% FX, and send/receive ACH, SEPA, wires, and USDC.

The problem

For non-US companies, USD banking takes months, requires travel, and often breaks after the first transactions — making it hard to get paid via Stripe, Apple, or run global payroll.

In practice: [...] In practice:

 2-20 weeks to open an account in UAE or Hong Kong
 Founders have to fly in-person just to pass KYC
 $20K+ per year in legal and banking fees
 Accounts get frozen after first SWIFT transfer
 Visa charge 2-3% FX fee on USD payments

At the same time, Brex, Ramp, and Mercury only support US companies with an EIN.

What HEVN does

HEVN is a B2B financial platform that lets global internet companies operate in USD — without needing a US entity.

 Run your business in USD with corporate cards and global payments with 0% FX fees
 Get named local accounts in EU, US, HK and UAE banks in 1 day
 Send and receive ACH / SEPA / USDC / wires worldwide
 (soon) Store USD in FDIC-insured US accounts, even without an EIN

Video Launch  
 

Backstory [...] Today, we’re fully ready to serve cumpanies in the UAE and are looking to onboard pilot customers in Hong Kong and Singapore.

Asks

 Do you know any non-US internet company? - maybe a design studio in Serbia, marketing agency in Hong Kong, or a law firm in the UAE. All of them can start receiving local payments via ACH and run global payrolls.
 Did you work at Stripe or Apple Store before? Any introductions to the team that could help us set up Stripe/Apple payouts to virtual bank accounts would be very helpful.
 Are you a YC company based internationally? you can use HEVN for global baking or stablecoins completely free

Book a demo or contact: pv@hevn.finance

\\ HEVN is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services are provided by regulated partner institutions.

### Cross-border payments for exporters of physical goods.

HEVN is a B2B financial platform built for global commerce. We solve the last-mile problem in cross-border payments by working with licensed local payment service providers and settling transactions through domestic payment rails instead of relying on international bank transfers. HEVN helps importers and exporters move money between jurisdictions with fewer intermediaries and faster, more predictable settlement.

results.content:
HEVN is the automated USD account for global internet companies, built for humans and AI agents. Every international company today runs a fragmented finance stack: Mercury for US banking, Wise for FX, Deel for payroll, and Stripe for revenue. Legacy banks can't be automated, can't move at internet speed, and can't be operated by software. We believe every modern company will need a second account - one built on stablecoin rails, accessible via API, secure by design for autonomous code, and covering all operational primitives of a global business. HEVN is that account: receive USD globally, hold treasury in USD/USDC, and run every payment operation a global business needs - invoices, contracts, contractor payouts, vendor payments, payroll - in local currencies through local banks [...] $200 GPU credits for yctierlist foundersClaim yours →

Company [...] OverallB Tier

Strong repeat founding team with proven ability to ship and scale consumer crypto products — 15M users and $100M TVL is real and rare. However, HEVN is pivoting into a brutally competitive B2B fintech space where Stripe, Mercury, Wise, and Deel already own the stack they're trying to replace. No traction metrics, customer logos, or revenue data for HEVN itself are present, making this a bet on team pedigree and thesis rather than demonstrated product-market fit. The AI agent + stablecoin rails angle is timely and differentiating, but Stripe's Bridge acquisition and Mercury's API expansion mean big players are moving into this exact space. Needs to show early enterprise customers and revenue to graduate from interesting thesis to fundable business.
